subject: Gatekeeper MAP: acceptance signals, conformance tests & cutover window
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Jenkins <alyssa@skywardhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Gatekeeper MAP draft + success signals

Hi Alyssa —

Attached is the first draft of the mutual action plan (MAP) focused on the evaluation success signals, exit gates, and a set of acceptance tests we propose for the Skyward pilot. High-level ask: can you review the acceptance criteria and confirm by EOD 2026-10-22 so we can lock timelines?

Key acceptance signals (proposed):
- Latency: P95 generation latency < 200ms for 256-token prompts during normal load (see test 02).
- Quality: >= 92% semantic concordance on the clinical summarization sampling suite (acceptance test 05).
- Safety/PII: 0 critical data-leak findings in the red-team sample of 500 prompts.
- Cost baseline: steady-state inferred cost <= target USD 0.12 / 1k tokens with recommended batching/quant.

Exit gates (hard stops):
1) Any data-residency or KMS requirement not satisfied for production flows.
2) Security controls (SOC2 evidence, audit logging) not demonstrably present within the pilot window.
3) Failure to meet regression thresholds across two consecutive weekly smoke runs.

Proposed acceptance tests (referenced in attached acceptance-test-cases.md):
- Test 01: End-to-end latency under nominal traffic (3 runs, median P95).
- Test 02: Load soak to trigger autoscaling and check latency/cold-start behavior.
- Test 05: Clinical concordance benchmark (1000-case holdout).
- Test 08: KV/prefix cache verification and consistency checks for sessioned chat.
- Test 12: Audit log extraction & retention verification (sample retrieval + TTL enforcement).

Attachments: skyward-map-draft-v1.xlsx (MAP timeline + RACI), acceptance-test-cases.md (detailed test steps).

Next steps: I can hop on a 30m call this week to walk the tests with your engineering and procurement teams — proposed slots Thu 10/21 10:00-11:00 PT or Fri 10/22 13:00-14:00 PT.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
--
Redwood Inference

Date: 2026-10-18T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Gatekeeper MAP draft + success signals

Thanks Evelyn — quick read-through and a few immediate clarifications from our side:

1) Data residency: the pilot must guarantee that all PHI used in the acceptance tests remains in our us-west region and be encrypted with our KMS key. Can you confirm Redwood private deployment or dedicated pool options for that?
2) Audit logs: we need a sample extract demonstrating 90-day retention and record-level timestamps (will review the acceptance-test-cases.md but flagging here).
3) Model fallbacks: during training/test runs we may want an explicit fallback to the smaller quantized model if latency spikes. Is that supported in the MAP?

Procurement note: I attached a quick procurement checklist that lists the redline items legal is likely to ask for — helps with sequencing the DocuSign round.

We also prefer to nudge sign-off to Mon 10/25 if possible; our infra team is tight this week but can prioritize the Thu or Fri walkthrough if you can do earlier times.

—Alyssa
Alyssa Jenkins
Head of Integrations | Skyward Health
Attachments: procurement-checklist.pdf

Subject: RE: Gatekeeper MAP draft + success signals — test mapping and technical notes

Alyssa / Evelyn — quick technical mapping to the acceptance tests and a couple of recommended additions:  

- Data residency / KMS: Redwood Dedicated can be pinned to a us-west cluster and we can map a customer-managed KMS (HSM-backed). For the MAP, I'll add an "evidence" task: provide a KMS setup doc and a sample encrypted audit log retrieval (Test 12).

- Fallbacks: yes — we support policy-based routing to model-variants. Suggest an explicit test: Test 14 (fallback verification) — simulate synthetic latency to primary model and assert traffic shifts to quantized variant while maintaining quality bounds.

- Stress/soak: add Test 20 — 4-hour soak at 1.5x expected QPS to validate autoscaling and KV-cache warmup behavior. This will exercise cold-starts and reveal degradations before pilot.

- Rollback triggers: propose an automated rollback if (a) semantic concordance drops >6% vs baseline OR (b) >1 critical security finding. Add those as gating rules in the MAP RACI matrix.

- Quick implementation notes for acceptance-test-cases.md: include exact curl examples to hit the streaming endpoint with kv_id header, and a sample script to extract per-token timings. I'll drop a draft snippet into the acceptance file.

Happy to review the updated MAP after Marissa incorporates procurement/legal asks.

Marcus Lin
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference

Alyssa — attaching an updated MAP (skyward-map-v2.xlsx) that incorporates Marcus's technical tests, the additional soak/fallback tests, and a condensed pass/fail table at the top. I also appended a short procurement sequencing sheet so procurement can see dependencies (legal review -> security evidence -> PO).

Summary of changes from v1:
- Added Test14 (fallback verification) and Test20 (4h soak) as Marcus suggested.
- Explicit KMS evidence task and a sample audit-log extraction (Test12).
- Rollback conditions added to the "Exit gates" tab with responsible owners.
- Cutover / go-live window: target preparatory sign-off week of 2026-10-25, cutover pilot week of 2026-11-01 if all acceptance tests green.

DocuSign: I'm including a link to the DocuSign intake in the MAP (https://docusign.com/link/ABCD-1234). If procurement/legal have redlines, flag them inline in the v2 spreadsheet and we can coordinate a redline call.

Requested action: Can you confirm the KMS/region requirement and whether procurement still needs the extended 10/25 sign-off window? If yes, we'll shift the final test run to Fri 10/29 and keep the 11/01 pilot week.

Attachments: skyward-map-v2.xlsx

Thanks Marissa — reviewed v2 and ran it by procurement and infra. Agreed items: 

- KMS/region: we confirm us-west requirement; procurement will provide a key_id and onboarding steps by Tue 10/26.
- Audit logs: 90-day retention during pilot; for production we'll scope longer retention (legal TBD).
- Cutover: we accept the 11/01 pilot week as long as the final green run completes by 10/29. Procurement is comfortable with signing the intake by 10/25; sending an intent-to-proceed PDF now.

Minor redline request: in the Exit gates section please explicitly note a maximum 7-year retention cap for archived records in case legal requires (we'll confirm exact language during SOW).

Next steps: Alyssa to share KMS key_id on Tue 10/26 -> Marcus to validate KMS integration -> Marissa to schedule final smoke run for 10/28 (backup 10/29). We'll plan a 30m cutover readiness sync on 10/30.

Attaching signed intent-to-proceed. Looking forward to the pilot.

—Alyssa
